records.name: Biotechnology
records.overview: The Department of Biotechnology was established in 2006 and oﬀers undergraduate program in B.E., postgraduate (M.Sc. Engineering by Research) and Doctoral (Ph.D.) under the Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), Karnataka. The Department is recognized as a Research Centre in the year 2011. The Department is committed to produce competent and ethically responsible biotechnology professionals. Academic and research activities in the Department includes Bioinformatics, Molecular Biology, Fermentation Technology, Nanobiotechnology, Systems Biology, and Big Data Analytics. These thrust areas are supported by a team of six well-qualiﬁed and experienced faculty members whose expertise includes OMICS technologies, Biomolecular Simulations and Dynamics, Bioprocess Engineering, Nanomedicine, Applied Microbial Biotechnology, and Biopolymer Technology. The Department has received ﬁnancial support from KBITs, Government of Karnataka, and other funding organizations for infrastructure development, and academic initiatives. The Department has successfully oﬀered one-year Postgraduate Diploma in Bioinformatics and Big Data Analytics, supported by KBITs and the Government of Karnataka in the past. The Department has also executed several sponsored research projects by funding organizations such as KBITs, VGST, DBT, DST, SERB, and VTU. Department actively promotes Research and Innovations through industry collaboration and internships through MOUs and related activities

records.overview: The Department of Chemical Engineering at SIT stands out to be the First Private Engineering College in Karnataka to offer B.E. in Chemical Engineering. The Department was established in the year 1974 with the undergraduate Chemical Engineering program and with time, the department has transformed itself into one of high repute offering doctoral programs. B.E. Chemical Engineering Programme has been accredited by National Board of Accreditation (NBA), New Delhi, wide their file no.: 25-113-2010-NBA, dated 04-112019, for a period of three years, from the academic year 2019-20 to 2021-2022, up to 30-06-2022. The department has over the years been working towards achieving its Vision and Mission which are in tune with the Institute’s Vision and Mission and also a well laid-out quality policy being adopted in all its activities. records.overview: The Department of Civil Engineering has been in existence since the inception of SIT in 1963. It has grown into a full-fledged department with specializations in all the major areas of Civil Engineering. The academic programmes offered by the department are B.E. in Civil Engineering, M.Tech (Structural Engineering), M.Tech (Transportation Engineering & Management), M.Sc. Engg (by research), and Ph.D. The departmental academic activities include designing curriculum for the contemporary needs of the civil engineering profession, delivering it through appropriately designed teaching methods at UG and PG levels, and assessing the effectiveness of delivery through examinations, quizzes, etc., along with career counseling for students. Other co-curricular academic activities are designed to fill gaps in the curriculum. These include field visits, participation in workshops, conferences, hackathons, design competitions, ideathons, etc. Students of the Civil Engineering department also participate in extracurricular activities such as sports, social service (NSS), yoga, NCC, etc. In addition to academic activities, the department is involved in research and development work and offers consultancy and technical services to industry and society. With the introduction of PG programs and recognition of the department as a VTU research centre, the focus widened to PG studies and research in addition to UG activities. Faculty members are encouraged to upgrade their qualifications and improve their knowledge base. With SIT becoming an autonomous institution under VTU in 2007, curricula have been continuously updated to meet industry needs. The department has adopted an outcome-based assessment system since 2014. Around 70% of graduating students are placed in industry, while 30% pursue higher studies or entrepreneurship. The alumni of the department are employed in academic institutions, industry, and government organizations across different states of the country and abroad, with many occupying prestigious positions. The department is recognized as one of the best Civil Engineering departments in the state of Karnataka

The department takes pride in its strong alumni network of over 1700 graduates, many of whom have made significant contributions in academia, industry, entrepreneurship, and public service across the globe. Their accomplishments stand as a testament to the quality of education and mentorship provided. With a curriculum designed to meet industry needs and supported by hands-on learning, the department maintains an impressive track record of student placements across top-tier companies in manufacturing, consulting, IT, analytics, and service sectors. records.name: Master of Computer Applications
records.overview: The Department of Master of Computer Applications (MCA) at Siddaganga Educational Society is committed to providing quality education, research opportunities, and industry-oriented training in the field of computer applications. The programme, autonomous since 2008, is affiliated with Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), Belagavi, and approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), New Delhi. In 2011, VTU Recognized MCA research center which promotes research activities, innovation, and advanced studies in the field of computer applications. The department equipped with state-of-the-art laboratories and modern computing facilities, the programme emphasizes industry-oriented education and practical learning. The department strengthens industry interaction through collaborative teaching, adjunct faculty, industry-specific electives, expert talks, and skill-development programs that prepare students for real-world challenges. Several student-centric initiatives foster innovation, collaboration, and professional growth. These include the technical fest “Zerone,” the coding club “Pidepippers,” the departmental newsletter “InfoVista,” and the “Buddy Program,” which provides alumni-supported mentoring. In addition, specialized training in technical and communication skills helps students to enhance their employability and professional competence. With a strong focus on hands-on learning, continuous curriculum updates, and industry–academia collaboration, the programme consistently achieves excellent outcomes, with nearly 95% of eligible students securing placements annually. This reflects the department’s commitment to academic excellence, research, innovation, and preparing graduates to thrive in the evolving digital era
